run_visEFT_singleSubject: run the visEFT_singleSubject function to visualize EFT fitting output on COCO images with SMPL mesh rendering
run_getRenderer: run the getRenderer function to create a mesh or densepose renderer with geo normal or densepose mode
run_conv_3djoint_2djoint: run the conv_3djoint_2djoint function to convert 3D SMPL joints to 2D image coordinates
run_loadCOCOAnnot: run the loadCOCOAnnot function to load and index COCO annotation JSON data by annotation ID
run_main: run the main module with argparse to visualize EFT SMPL fitting results on COCO dataset images
